# Vektena cars v1

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool on 2026-10-05. The transparent PNG is copied unchanged; atlas frames select four north-facing vehicles. Scene 16 rotates the sprites for each lane and preserves aspect ratio within 48 × 84 px. Existing movement and yielding rules are retained.

## Final prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production pixel-art sprite atlas for moving vehicles in PETOA, a top-down 16-bit JRPG city. Exactly FOUR distinct vehicles arranged in a strict 2-column by 2-row grid on true transparent alpha background, plenty of empty margins and gaps. ALL cars point straight UP toward the top of the image, viewed directly overhead, orthographic TOP view, no isometric angles. Same scale and aligned cell centers. Vehicles look maintained but repaired, surviving machines in a future society rebuilding after nuclear war: muted worn paint, small mismatched replacement panels and rust spots, sturdy ordinary passenger or utility vehicles, not wrecks. Top-left: compact muted teal hatchback; top-right: rusty ochre small sedan; bottom-left: olive utility wagon with a simple roof rack; bottom-right: faded brick red compact delivery van. Clear hood at top, windshield, roof, rear window at bottom, small dark visible tires on sides, tiny warm headlamps at the upper front and red tail lights at lower rear. Retro chunky LOW RESOLUTION PIXEL ART, hard square pixel edges, limited 16-bit palette, dark outlines and stepped pixel highlights; design each vehicle as if a 32x56 sprite scaled with nearest-neighbor, no smooth shading or antialiasing. Consistent lengths and width to fit 72px traffic lanes; viewed in game at about 46x80px. No text, logos, labels, roads, background, borders, shadows, exhaust, glows, weapons, neon, cyberpunk styling or realistic photographic rendering. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Grid 2x2, all four point UP.
